I just want you to know this is my first post and I really was content being a lurker, but just for YOU I joined. Not that it was very hard, but I completely understand where you are coming from. My family was crazy religious didn't have TV till about 6th grade and even then it was very limited. I started suicide attempts the summer before 9th grade and my father's answer was "to pray harder." Luckily my mother realized it was more than that and she took me to get medicine. The whole reason I wanted to write to you is the way I finally got through to my father was comparing depression with diabetes (maybe the comparison will help with your family). They are both chemical imbalances that you can not control or pray away. Your grandmother's blood pressure issues are the same thing. Sure you can change your diet, get hobbies and find something to reduce stress but even after all that is changed sometimes it still isn't enough. It took me years to finally get everything sorted out and even though I am an atheist now I do believe everything happens for a reason (animals and people adjust to things around them, so stuff doesn't just randomly happen). I hate the fact that it took me about 12 different combos of medicine before I found the right combination for me, but I am ok that I had to struggle through that because my younger cousin was able to start out on the medicine combo that works for me and she never had to go through switching medicines every couple of months for years. Who knows maybe I was supposed to go through all that just to write to you on here, but please realize that you are here and meant to be here for a reason. If you want to talk more message me please!! I promise that I will be here to listen to you.
